questions.stem: A 32-year P3 comes to OPD with AUB. Menarche was at age 13 years, and she has had regular cycles till 1 year ago. She then began to have delayed periods every 45-60 days with heavy bleeding, clots but no cramping. She has not had her period in 4 months. She has no hot flushes, acne, or abnormal hair growth. She takes levo-thyroxine for hypothyroidism and has had a tubal ligation done. Height is 160 cm, weight is 120kg. P/S is normal. Bimanual exam is limited by body habitus. A urine pregnancy test is negative. Lab tests are as follows: TSH- 2.9, Prolactin: 16, LH: 15 What is the most likely diagnosis?
